summary: Defines how an IKEv2 client and gateway can resume a previous session with fewer round trips and less cryptographic work. This helps remote-access VPNs where EAP authentication is expensive or a gateway fails over. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: If you already showed your badge this morning, a guard can wave you in quickly when you come back instead of checking everything again. This lets a VPN session restart fast.

questions: how does ikev2 session resumption work
how to reconnect a vpn without full authentication
